cohort: 150 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies between 30 and 41 weeks gestation, with or without GDM
finding: Fetal pancreatic echogenicity and circumference measurements were significantly higher in pregnant women with GDM and were associated with higher HbA1c levels and increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Pancreas measurements were significantly higher in pregnant women who had a cesarean delivery.
